<DESCRIPTION>CONSULTING SERVICES AGREEMENT BETWEEN AMERICAN FUSION, INC. AND BRENT NELSON DATED MARCH 1, 2026
<TEXT>
<HTML>
<HEAD>
     <TITLE></TITLE>
</HEAD>
<BODY STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif">

<P STYLE="text-align: right; margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Exhibit 10.1</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.9pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: none">CONSULTING
SERVICES <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">AGREEMENT</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">This
Consulting Services Agreement (the &ldquo;Agreement&rdquo;) is made and entered into as of March 1, 2026 (the &ldquo;Effective Date&rdquo;),
by and between American Fusion Inc., a Texas corporation (the &ldquo;Company&rdquo;), and Brent Nelson, an individual (the &ldquo;Consultant&rdquo;).
The Company and the Consultant may be referred to herein individually as a &ldquo;Party&rdquo; and collectively as the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">&ldquo;Parties.&rdquo;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.9pt 0pt 0; text-align: center"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: none; letter-spacing: 0.0pt">RECITALS</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>&nbsp;</B></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>WHEREAS</B>,
the Company desires to retain the Consultant to provide executive leadership, strategic business development, transaction sourcing and
execution, financing strategy, corporate growth, investor-facing leadership, public company strategy, and related executive consulting
services in connection with the Company&rsquo;s business and long-term strategic <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">development;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>WHEREAS</B>,
the Company desires for Consultant to serve as the Company&rsquo;s Executive Chairman pursuant to this Agreement, and Consultant is willing
to serve in such capacity;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 20pt 0pt 4.5pt; text-indent: 31.5pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>WHEREAS,
</B>the parties acknowledge and agree that the Consultant, in serving as Executive Chairman of the Company, acts in a fiduciary capacity
to the Company and its stockholders, and the parties desire that the protections, indemnification rights, and other provisions set forth
herein apply fully to such service;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 4.5pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 31.5pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>WHEREAS,
</B>the parties acknowledge and agree that Consultant is not being engaged as an employee of the Company, and that this Agreement reflects
an independent contractor relationship on a 1099 basis, separate and apart from any current employment arrangement, provided that the
parties acknowledge the possibility of a future transition to a formal employee executive relationship under a separate written agreement
if mutually agreed;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>WHEREAS,</B>
the Company desires to compensate Consultant through a monthly cash retainer, together with the possibility of discretionary bonuses
as approved by the Company;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 20pt 0pt 0; text-indent: 0.5in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>WHEREAS,</B>
the parties desire to set forth the terms and conditions of such engagement in writing, including confidentiality, indemnification, expense
reimbursement, and other protections applicable to Consultant in his fiduciary and executive capacity, and the Company&rsquo;s commitment
to use commercially reasonable efforts to obtain and maintain directors&rsquo; and officers&rsquo; liability insurance coverage covering
Consultant in his capacity as Executive Chairman as soon as commercially practicable.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 4.5pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 31.5pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>NOW,
THEREFORE</B>, in consideration of the mutual covenants and promises contained herein, and for other good and valuable consideration,
the receipt and sufficiency of which are hereby acknowledged, the Parties hereby agree as follows:</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 4.5pt; text-align: justify; text-indent: 31.5pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; width: 100%"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top; text-align: justify">
<TD STYLE="width: 15pt; text-align: left"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>1.</B></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="width: 5pt"></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: underline solid"><B>APPOINTMENT
                                            OF CONSULTANT</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">.</FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">
                                            The Company hereby appoints Consultant, and Consultant hereby accepts such appointment, to
                                            provide consulting and executive services to the Company on a non-exclusive basis during
                                            the Term of this Agreement, subject to the terms and conditions set forth herein.</FONT></TD>
</TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.1pt 0pt 0.25in"></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In
connection with such engagement, Consultant shall serve as the Company&rsquo;s Executive Chairman for the duration of the Term, or until
earlier resignation or removal in accordance with applicable law and the Company&rsquo;s governing documents.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
parties acknowledge and agree that Consultant&rsquo;s service as Executive Chairman is undertaken pursuant to this Agreement in a consulting
and fiduciary executive capacity and does not create an <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">employment relationship unless and until
superseded by a separate written employment agreement.</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0.0pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Consistent
with Consultant&rsquo;s role as Executive Chairman and controlling stockholder of the Company, Consultant shall have authority to act
on behalf of and bind the Company in the ordinary course consistent with his executive authority, subject to applicable law, the Company&rsquo;s
governing documents, and any limitations imposed by the Board of Directors.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>2.</B></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: underline solid"><B>CONSULTANT
                                            SERVICES</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">.</FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">
                                            Consultant, in his capacity as an independent contractor acting as Executive Chairman, will
                                            provide services to the Company during the Term when and as reasonably requested by the Company
                                            or as otherwise appropriate consistent with Consultant&rsquo;s executive role. Said Services
                                            shall include, but not be limited to, the following:</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">a)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Executive
                                            leadership and strategic oversight relating to the Company&rsquo;s corporate development,
                                            growth initiatives, financing strategy, public company positioning, and long-term business
                                            objectives;</FONT></TD></TR><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
                                                                        </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">b)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Business
                                            development, strategic partnership development, commercial relationship building, transaction
                                            origination, and corporate opportunity sourcing on behalf of the <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">Company;</FONT></FONT></TD></TR><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
                                                                                                                                                                                  </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">c)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Leadership
                                            and support relating to mergers, acquisitions, strategic investments, joint ventures, licensing
                                            arrangements, business combinations, and other strategic <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">transactions;</FONT></FONT></TD></TR><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
                                                                                                                                                                               </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">d)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Executive-facing
                                            investor, stakeholder, market, and institutional relationship management, including positioning
                                            the Company with strategic counterparties, financing sources, industry participants, and
                                            commercial partners;</FONT></TD></TR><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
                                                                                 </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.5in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: -0.05pt">e)</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Strategic
                                            support relating to capital formation initiatives, financing alternatives, corporate growth
                                            opportunities, and transaction structuring, provided that Consultant shall not engage in
                                            activities requiring broker-dealer registration unless separately authorized and appropriately
                                            licensed;</FONT></TD></TR><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
                                                                      </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">

                                            and coordination with executive management, attorneys, auditors, accountants, investor relations
                                            professionals, financing sources, and other service providers in furtherance of the Company&rsquo;s
                                            strategic objectives;</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

                                            other executive, strategic, leadership, business development, and transaction-related services
                                            as may be reasonably appropriate consistent with Consultant&rsquo;s role.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Company acknowledges that Consultant will serve primarily in an executive leadership, business development, strategic transaction, and
public company growth capacity. Consultant&rsquo;s service as Executive Chairman is undertaken pursuant to this Agreement in a consulting
and fiduciary executive capacity as set forth herein.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><B>3.</B></FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: underline solid"><B>COMPENSATION
                                            TO CONSULTANT</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">.</FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">
                                            As full and complete consideration for the services to be rendered by Consultant during the
                                            Term, the Company shall compensate Consultant in accordance with this Section 3.</FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">3.1.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Monthly
                                            Retainer. As full and complete consideration for the consulting and consulting services to
                                            be rendered by Consultant during the Term, the Company shall pay Consultant a monthly cash
                                            retainer of Fifteen Thousand Dollars (US$15,000) (the &ldquo;Retainer&rdquo;), payable in
                                            advance on the first (1st) day of each calendar month during the Term.</FONT></TD></TR><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
                                                                                                                                   </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">3.2.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Initial
                                            Payment. The first monthly Retainer payment shall be deemed earned as of March 1, 2026 and
                                            shall be due immediately upon execution of this Agreement if not previously <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">paid.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
                                                                                                                                                                                          </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">3.3.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">Discretionary
                                            Bonuses. The Company may, in its sole and absolute discretion, award Consultant additional
                                            compensation or bonuses from time to time in recognition of services rendered, milestones
                                            achieved, transactions completed, or other extraordinary contributions. Any such bonus may
                                            be paid in cash or other consideration as approved by the Company and documented in writing.
                                            Any such bonus may include equity compensation, cash compensation, or other consideration
                                            as approved by the Board of Directors or otherwise authorized in accordance with the Company&rsquo;s
                                            governing <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">documents.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD>&nbsp;</TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify; padding-right: 17.85pt">&nbsp;</TD></TR>
                                                                                                                             </TABLE>

<TABLE CELLPADDING="0" CELLSPACING="0" WIDTH="100%" STYLE="font: 11pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 0pt; margin-bottom: 0pt"><TR STYLE="vertical-align: top">
<TD STYLE="width: 0.25in"></TD><TD STYLE="width: 0.3in"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">3.4.</FONT></TD><TD STYLE="text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">No
                                            Equity Compensation. The parties acknowledge and agree that Consultant&rsquo;s compensation
                                            under this Agreement is intended to be cash-based only, Except as may be approved in a separate
                                            written instrument or Board authorization, Consultant shall not be entitled to any stock,
                                            options, warrants, or other equity compensation under this <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">Agreement.</FONT></FONT></TD></TR></TABLE>

<P STYLE="margin-top: 0; margin-bottom: 0">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: underline solid">CONSULTANT&rsquo;S
OPINIONS, ADVICE AND <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">CONFIDENTIALITY</FONT></FONT><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; letter-spacing: 0.0pt">.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: bold 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Company acknowledges that all financial and corporate Consulting Services (written or oral) given by Consultant to the Company in connection
with Consultant&rsquo;s engagement are intended solely for the benefit and use of the Company, and the Company agrees that no person
or entity other than the Company shall be entitled to make use of or rely upon the advice of Consultant given specifically and exclusively
to the Company pursuant to this Agreement, and no such <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">opinion or advice shall be used in any other
manner or for any other purpose, nor may the Company make
any public references to Consultant, or use the Consultant&rsquo;s name in any annual reports or any reports or releases of the Company,
without the Consultant&rsquo;s prior written consent.</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify">&nbsp;</P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Consultant acknowledges that Consultant shall keep in confidence any information that the Company provides to Consultant pursuant to
this Agreement. Notwithstanding the foregoing, Consultant shall not be required to maintain confidentiality with respect to information
(i) which is or becomes part of the public domain not due to the breach of this Agreement by <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">Consultant;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0.0pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">(ii)
of which it had independent knowledge prior to disclosure; (iii) which comes into the possession of Consultant in the normal and routine
course of his own business from and through independent non-confidential sources; or (iv) which is required to be disclosed by Consultant
by laws, rule or regulators. If Consultant is requested or required to disclose any information supplied to it by the Company, Consultant
shall, unless prohibited by law, promptly notify the Company of such request(s) so that the Company may seek an appropriate protective
order.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: underline solid"><B>TERM
OF AGREEMENT; TERMINATION: EFFECT THEREOF</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">.</FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"> The term
of this Agreement shall be for six (6) months commencing on March 1, 2026 (the &ldquo;Initial Term&rdquo;)
and shall automatically renew for successive six (6) month periods unless either party provides written notice of non-renewal at least
thirty (30) days prior to the expiration of the then-current term, unless otherwise mutually agreed by the parties. Either party may
terminate the Agreement for Cause during any term by providing the other party with 30 days written notice of termination for Cause.
Cause shall be defined as either Consultant or any officer, director or control person of the Company being, subsequent to execution
of this Agreement, indicted, arrested or convicted by any court of any U.S. state or The United States of America or censured, barred
or otherwise formally disciplined by the SEC, FINRA or any U.S. state securities commissioner. If the Agreement is terminated for Cause
by either party prior to the six-month anniversary of this Agreement, the Consultant shall retain a prorated portion of the fully earned
compensation for services rendered up to the date of termination, calculated on a 365-day year. If termination for Cause occurs after
the six-month anniversary, the Consultant shall retain the entire Compensation.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: underline solid"><B>EXPENSES</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">.</FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">
Each of the parties hereto shall be solely responsible for any and all of its own and costs and expenses related to the negotiation and
preparation of this Agreement. It is agreed and acknowledged by the Company that the Consultant may incur out of pocket costs and expenses
in connection with the provision of services to the Company hereunder. The Company hereby agrees to advance such costs or expenses or
to repay any such costs or expenses incurred by Consultant within fifteen days of Consultant presenting an invoice for such expenses,
as long as such expenses are approved by the Company in advance.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">&nbsp;</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt; text-decoration: underline solid"><B>INDEPENDENT
CONTRACTOR</B></FONT><B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">.</FONT></B><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"> Consultant shall act at all times hereunder
as an independent contractor as that term is defined in the Internal Revenue Code of 1986, as amended, with respect to the Company, and
not as an employee, partner, agent or co-venturer of or with the Company. Except as set forth herein, the Company shall neither have
nor exercise control or direction whatsoever over the operations of Consultant and Consultant shall neither have nor exercise any control
or direction whatsoever over the employees, agents or subcontractors hired by the Company.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Company agrees that it shall indemnify and hold harmless Consultant, its members, managers, officers, employees, agents, affiliates,
and controlling persons within the meaning of Section 20 of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934 and Section 15 of the Securities Act
of 1933, each as amended (any and all of whom are referred to as an &ldquo;Indemnified Party&rdquo;), from and against any and all losses,
claims, damages, liabilities, or expenses, and all actions in respect thereof (including, but not limited to, all legal or other expenses
reasonably incurred by an Indemnified Party in connection with the investigation, preparation, defense or settlement of any claim, action
or proceeding, whether or not resulting in any liability), incurred by an Indemnified Party with respect to, caused by, or otherwise
arising out of any Indemnified Party performing the services contemplated hereunder , including in connection with Brent Nelson&rsquo;s
service as Chief Executive Officer of the Company; provided, however, the Company will not be liable, or shall not be obligated to indemnify
or hold harmless, to the extent, and only to the extent, that any loss, claim, damage, liability or expense is finally judicially determined
to have resulted primarily from Consultant's gross negligence or bad faith in performing such services. If a legal or regulatory action
is brought against the Consultant in an official capacity, the Company shall retain a tier 1 law firm to defend the Consultant. Without
limiting the foregoing, the indemnification provided herein shall apply to claims arising from acts or omissions undertaken by Brent
Nelson in his capacity as Executive Chairman of the Company or as Consultant.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In
addition to and without limitation of their entitlement to indemnification to the extent provided by the Exhibit A hereof, solely with
respect to the Consultant, each Indemnified Party shall continue to be entitled to indemnification with respect to claims and proceedings
that relate to or arise from any Prior Acts or Matters that occurred prior to the Effective Date.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 45.8pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">If
the indemnification provided for herein is conclusively determined (by an entry of final judgment by a court of competent jurisdiction
and the expiration of the time or denial of the right to appeal) to be unavailable or insufficient to hold any Indemnified Party harmless
in respect to any losses, claims, damages, liabilities or expenses referred to herein, then the Company shall contribute to the amounts
paid or payable by such Indemnified Party in such proportion as is appropriate and equitable under all circumstances taking into account
the relative benefits received by the Company on the one hand and Consultant on the other, from the transaction or proposed transaction
under the Agreement or, if allocation on that basis is not permitted under applicable law, in such proportion as is appropriate to reflect
not only the relative benefits received by the Company on the one hand and Consultant on the other, but also the relative fault of the
Company and Consultant; provided, however, in no event shall the aggregate contribution of Consultant and/or any Indemnified Party be
in excess of the net compensation actually received by Consultant and/or such Indemnified Party pursuant to this Agreement.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
Company shall not settle or compromise or consent to the entry of any judgment in or otherwise seek to terminate any pending or threatened
action, claim, suit or proceeding in which any Indemnified Party is or could be a party and as to which indemnification or contribution
could have been sought by such Indemnified Party hereunder (whether or not such Indemnified Party is a party thereto), unless such consent
or termination includes an express unconditional release of such Indemnified Party, reasonably satisfactory in form and substance to
such Indemnified Party, from all losses, claims, damages, liabilities or expenses arising out of such action, claim, suit or proceeding.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 17.85pt 0pt 0; text-align: justify; text-indent: 45.8pt"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"><FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: -0.25pt">&nbsp;</FONT></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">In
the event any Indemnified Party shall incur any expenses covered by this Exhibit A, the Company shall reimburse the Indemnified Party
for such covered expenses within ten (10) business days of the Indemnified Party's delivery to the Company of an invoice therefor, with
receipts attached. Such obligation of the Company to so advance funds may be conditioned upon the Company's receipt of a written undertaking
from the Indemnified Party to repay such amounts within ten (10) business days after a final, non-appealable judicial determination that
such Indemnified Party was not entitled to indemnification hereunder.</FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin: 0pt 0"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt"></FONT></P>

<P STYLE="font: 10pt Times New Roman, Times, Serif; margin-top: 6pt; margin-bottom: 6pt; margin-left: 0pt; text-indent: 20pt; text-align: justify"><FONT STYLE="font-size: 10pt">The
foregoing indemnification and contribution provisions are not in lieu of, but in addition to, any rights which any Indemnified Party
may have at common law hereunder or otherwise, and shall remain in full force and effect following the expiration or termination of Consultant's
engagement and shall be binding on any successors or assigns of the Company and successors or assigns to all or substantially all of
the Company's business or assets. These indemnification provisions shall survive any termination of the Agreement for a period of two
(2) <FONT STYLE="letter-spacing: 0pt">years.</FONT></FONT></P>
